body:
Decision (maintainer, 2026-11-08): **option 2 - the machine's axis really moves the other way.** Not a view-only flip, not a part mirror, not controller mirror-image. The CAM side stays right-handed (ISO 841); generation, verification and sim are unchanged; the machine file states which axis is inverted and the post translates for the controller: inverted coordinate and I/J/K signs, G2<->G3 and G41<->G42 in planes containing exactly one inverted axis, refusals by name for anything not yet verified (helical/thread cycles, polar, rotary/multi-axis on that axis).

Sub-issues:
- #373 machine file: per-axis direction
- #374 post: inverted axis written correctly (sign, I/J/K, G2/G3, G41/G42) + conformance goldens
- #375 viewport / setup sheet / NC header show the inverted axis

Closing this umbrella per the needs-research rule; the work lives in the sub-issues.
